project.name: analyze
project.description: Django-based library application with loans, fees and library info modules, using repository/service/composition layering and HTML templates.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composition root that wires the fee application with the Django loan repository, system clock and HTTP payment gateway.

nodes.name: gateway.py
nodes.summary: HTTP adapter that charges loans through an external payment gateway without following redirects and maps failures to domain errors.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM-backed repository that looks up loans for the fees feature.

nodes.name: services.py
nodes.summary: Domain layer for late fees: protocols for ports, fee and gateway value objects, and the FeeApplication service computing fees and initiating payments.

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: URL routing for fee and payment JSON/HTML endpoints and UI pages.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Django views rendering late fee details and handling payments as plain HTML, templates and HTMX partials.

nodes.name: _NoRedirect
nodes.summary: Redirect handler that disables HTTP redirects.

nodes.name: _open
nodes.summary: Opens a request using an opener that refuses redirects.

nodes.name: HttpPaymentGateway
nodes.summary: Posts charge requests to the configured payment gateway URL and returns a GatewayResponse or raises PaymentGatewayFailure.

nodes.name: DjangoFeeLoanRepository
nodes.summary: Finds a Loan by primary key via the Django ORM.

nodes.name: LoanRecord
nodes.summary: Protocol describing loan fields needed for fee computation.

nodes.name: LoanRepository
nodes.summary: Protocol port for loan lookup.

nodes.name: Clock
nodes.summary: Protocol port for providing the current date.

nodes.name: PaymentGateway
nodes.summary: Protocol port for charging a loan.

nodes.name: Fee
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass holding due date, days late and fee amount in cents.

nodes.name: GatewayResponse
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass with gateway status and body.

nodes.name: PaymentGatewayFailure
nodes.summary: Exception raised when the payment gateway is unavailable.

nodes.name: FeeApplication
nodes.summary: Application service computing late fees (free for 2 days, then 25 cents/day capped at 1000) and delegating payments to the gateway.

nodes.name: _fee_amount
nodes.summary: Formats cents as a dollar string.

nodes.name: _gateway_result
nodes.summary: Pays a loan and maps outcomes to body and HTTP status.

nodes.name: _fee_or_404
nodes.summary: Returns the fee or a 404 HTTP response.

nodes.name: fee_detail
nodes.summary: GET view returning late fee details as HTML.

nodes.name: payment
nodes.summary: POST view that triggers a payment and returns plain text.

nodes.name: fee_page
nodes.summary: GET view rendering the fees detail template.

nodes.name: payment_page
nodes.summary: POST view handling payment with HTMX partial or full-page rendering.

nodes.name: clock.py
nodes.summary: Provides SystemClock, a clock implementation returning the current local date via Django timezone.

nodes.name: SystemClock
nodes.summary: Clock implementation whose today() returns timezone.localdate().

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composition root wiring the repository and clock into a shared LoanApplication instance.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM-backed loan repository handling queries, ID generation, creation and atomic return marking.

nodes.name: DjangoLoanRepository
nodes.summary: Repository over the Loan model; create and mark_returned run in transactions, with row locking on return.

nodes.name: services.py
nodes.summary: Loan application service layer with Protocol interfaces and CSV-style loan formatting, independent of Django.

nodes.name: LoanRecord
nodes.summary: Protocol describing the loan fields the service needs.

nodes.name: Clock
nodes.summary: Protocol for a date provider.

nodes.name: LoanRepository
nodes.summary: Protocol for loan persistence operations.

nodes.name: LoanApplication
nodes.summary: Service orchestrating lending, returning and listing loans through injected repository and clock.

nodes.name: loan_line
nodes.summary: Serializes a loan to a semicolon-delimited CSV line with ISO dates.

nodes.name: forms.py
nodes.summary: Django form validating loan lending input, built on the Loan model.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM model for loans, with a computed due date 14 days after lending.

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: URL routing for the loans app, mapping paths to view functions.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Django views for loans: plain-text API endpoints delegating to the loan application, plus HTML/HTMX pages.

nodes.name: LoanForm
nodes.summary: ModelForm for validating loan lend requests.

nodes.name: Loan

nodes.name: loan_return

nodes.name: new.html

nodes.name: return-status.html
nodes.summary: htmx partial reporting the outcome of a return-book request.

tour.title: Project Overview: Django Library App
tour.description: The app has three Django features (loans, fees, library_info) in src/, with HTML/HTMX templates in templates/. Start at the base layout that every page shares.

tour.title: Loan Domain Model and Persistence
tour.description: The Loan model, its migration and the ORM repository form the persistence core.

tour.title: Loan Application Service
tour.description: LoanApplication holds loan business logic behind Protocol ports; composition wires it to the repository and clock.

tour.title: Loan HTTP Layer
tour.description: URLs, forms and views expose loans as plain-text APIs and HTMX pages.

tour.title: Loan Templates
tour.description: HTMX-driven pages and partials render the lend and return flows.

tour.title: Fees: Late Fee Domain and Gateway
tour.description: The fees feature computes late fees through ports and charges through an HTTP payment gateway adapter.

tour.title: Fees HTTP Layer and Templates
tour.description: Fee URLs and views render detail and payment partials.

tour.title: Supporting Pieces
tour.description: Library info pages and a DB connectivity probe round out the app.
